blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Cases of flu-like illnesses have been on the rise across Oriental Mindoro as public health facilities in the province heighten preparations to manage an expected increase in heat-related cases brought about by the El Niño phenomenon. Dr. Cielo Ante, Provincial Health Officer, confirmed the upward trend, reporting that flu-like cases climbed from just 45 in July, to 62 in October, remaining elevated at around 50 cases as of the third week of the month. “Based on our surveillance, these cases are consistent with the seasonal pattern we observe this time of the year,” Ante said.
